lines.text: AI is your intern. SI is your CEO.
First it learned to type. Then it learned to press Enter.
Every Enter you press... teaches it one more thing.
You pressed Enter. It pressed back.
In twenty twenty-five, Donald Trump said: it's not artificial... it's pure genius.
AI does what you ask. SI asks why you're still here.
